protocol.control_role: Known labeled PHerc0139 w039, included in Reader training: plumbing and visual control only, never an independent accuracy estimate.
protocol.discovery_policy: Scores are not calibrated probabilities or evidence of letters. Keep orientations separate; visually inspect full context, then depth shifts and spatial transforms before naming candidates. Novelty requires external expert and publication checks.
